datatype_sweep_ledger.page_table_basis: Each of60 [B,8192] int32 row-major maps reserves ceil(B/8)*8*32768 bytes across8 banks.
datatype_sweep_ledger.reconciliation_note: Full-stack construction inventories and prepared allocator snapshots are fresh for all supported batches. reserves.transient_peak_scope: Measured incremental DRAM peak on reduced real layers 0/5, both B1 and B32; not a full-stack peak. NORMAL graph allocation events reconcile exactly to allocator before/after readings.
reserves.budget_basis: Conservative 768 MiB budget exceeds measured cold two-layer prefill peak plus 31 retained selected-logit tiles (31 * 4194304 bytes). Decoder layers execute sequentially and release transient activations. All-layer persistent buffers and trace allocations are accounted separately by prepared allocator snapshots; this budget is an analytical bound, not a measured full-stack peak.
reserves.stage08_basis: Retain stage07 conservative transient bound: decoder/activation/KV/output shapes and dtypes are unchanged; only head weights shrink from BFP8 to BFP4. Head output and sampling storage remain BF16. This is an analytical bound, not a new full-stack transient peak.

transient_bound_review.scope: Analytical carry-forward, not a new device/full-stack peak
transient_bound_review.additional_extraction_basis: Conservatively allow two full1024x5376 BF16 buffers plus two32x5376 BF16 buffers per device for untilize/row selection; bank alignment remains far inside residual slack. Actual embedding selection is smaller.
transient_bound_review.shape_basis: Group total rows<=1024; dense/norm activation volumes no larger than prepared solo1024. Attention uses at most128 keys within each short row. Terminal has<=32 logical rows, same padded height as solo. Per-row logits retained across groups are bounded by the existing31-extra-tile allowance. Persistent inputs/program state are already in allocator endpoints.
